cohort: 1,341 adolescents aged 10-19 years who gave birth at a tertiary institution between 2012 and 2016
finding: Low Apgar scores (below 7 at 1 and 5 minutes) and low birth weight (less than 999g and between 1500-2499g) were significantly associated with neonatal death among adolescent mothers.
birth_weight: Low birth weight (less than 999g and between 1500-2499g)
